run_dump_prompts_text: run dump_prompts.py to export LOFT dataset prompts as text chunk files
run_dump_prompts_csv: run dump_prompts.py to export LOFT dataset prompts as a CSV file with prompt_id, prompt, and targets
run_dump_prompts_limited: run dump_prompts.py with max_examples to limit the number of dumped prompt examples
run_dump_prompts_custom_dir: run dump_prompts.py to dump prompts into a custom output directory
run_dump_prompts_multi_format: run dump_prompts.py to dump prompts in both text and csv formats
